s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful ulcerations of the lower limbs with a reticular purplish livedo pattern and chronic nonhealing ulcers
salient_findings: Recurrent painful ulcerations on both legs and feet
Reticular purplish livedo pattern over both lower limbs
Chronic, nonhealing ulcers on the lateral malleolus and the dorsum of the left foot
key_facts: 31-year-old woman
4-year history of recurrent painful ulcerations
No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease
Denies arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms
Takes no medications
Denies tobacco or illicit drug use
Reticular purplish livedo pattern noted on examination
Multiple chronic, nonhealing ulcers present
White atrophic scars on the lower legs and ankles

shortlist.label: Livedoid vasculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Reticular purplish livedo pattern and chronic nonhealing ulcers

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic nonhealing ulcers and systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Thromboangiitis obliterans
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and lower limb involvement

shortlist.label: Sneddon syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Livedo pattern and chronic nonhealing ulcers with possible vascular involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of recurrent painful ulcerations, reticular purplish livedo pattern, and white atrophic scars is most consistent with livedoid vasculopathy, a condition characterized by chronic, recurrent ulcerations and livedo reticularis due to thrombosis of small and medium-sized blood vessels.

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
rejected.why: No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease, and no other symptoms suggestive of antiphospholipid syndrome

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Lack of systemic symptoms such as arthralgia, and the presence of a more localized pattern of ulcerations and livedo reticularis

rejected.label: Thromboangiitis obliterans
rejected.why: Typically affects younger men who smoke, which does not match the patient's profile

rejected.label: Sneddon syndrome
rejected.why: Characterized by livedo reticularis and cerebrovascular events, which are not mentioned in the patient's presentation
